repository.supplied_main_binding: Root states baseline runtime equals Access main 499, tree 04d1d397; this review independently binds the local baseline and frozen working patch only.

scope.finding: Stored jobs omitted current per-kind capability checks at resume and new provider dispatch.
scope.actor_boundary: Approved owner or enrolled/trusted local managed client; no new authentication or OS privilege claim.
scope.review_mode: Manual static patch review; no delegation, repository code execution, test execution, network, production or repository writes.

invariant: Before clearing/requeueing an eligible stored job, and before any new provider invocation for initial or resumed queued work, validate current jobs plus the kind-specific vmRead/codeRead/testRun permissions and exact test selector. Preserve existing owner/enrolled entry, global pause/readOnly admission, root containment, fixed commands and lifecycle/evidence rules.

verification.observation: The same helper requires jobs, then vmRead for vm_inventory, codeRead for repo_diagnostics, and codeRead plus testRun plus an exact TEST_COMMANDS member for run_tests. KINDS and TEST_COMMANDS are Sets of fixed strings; case variants, prototype-property names and other aliases do not gain a branch.

Both production resume callers reach resumeJob. It reads the complete stored row and applies fresh validated toolkit permissions before its update. Global policy admission for MCP and bearer/Host/Origin admission for HTTP are unchanged.
verification.result: Both direct callers now reach the guard; no alternate production resume caller found in scoped source search.

verification.observation: Every provider invocation is preceded by requireJobCapabilities(await readToolkit(...), row.kind, row.command). Repository root/path and resource awaits occur before that read. There is no further await between the completed helper and invocation of vmOperation/codeOperation. The runner receives both initial and resumed queued rows through the same execute function.
verification.result: All three fixed provider dispatch branches are dominated by current kind authorization.

verification.observation: Confirmation, resumable-state and three-resume limit remain. Failed config/capability checks occur before clearing evidence or updating counts. The conditional update includes the observed state and resume_count, and changes must equal one. Legitimate production writers do not change kind/root/path/command; another resume changes state/count and cannot be overwritten after the asynchronous authorization read.
verification.result: No concrete lost-update or legitimate-state regression found in the scoped production writers.

verification.area: Malformed configuration and corrupt stored selectors
verification.observation: Missing toolkit defaults jobs to false; malformed/oversized/invalid-capability configuration throws. Unknown stored kinds are rejected at resume and before runner preflight. Invalid run_tests selectors are rejected before requeue or provider dispatch. Irrelevant command fields on the two non-test kinds cannot redirect their fixed provider calls.
verification.result: No fail-open configuration, kind alias or selector path found.

verification.area: Existing outer controls and side effects
verification.observation: Global enabled/readOnly/jobs admission, canonical root containment, Git-root validation, resource checks and fixed test selectors remain. Failed dispatch authorization is handled by the existing run catch as a failed/interrupted row with a bounded error and no provider result. Status/logs and cancellation code are unchanged.
verification.result: No concrete weakening of these controls or side-effect regression found.

verification.observation: Read the complete new test file and fixture helper. Tests describe disabled-kind resume with prior evidence preserved; initial/resumed repository dispatch denial; allowed git-diff-check; eligible terminal states and competing resumes; MCP routing/readable logs; malformed settings and persisted kind/selector corruption. Fixture setup targets its disposable repository and disables commit hooks/signing for that fixture.
verification.result: Source inspected only; no pass, failure, provider-call count or runtime side-effect claim inferred.

preexisting_scope_boundaries: Global policy is evaluated at runner tick admission (candidate jobs.mjs:208-214; baseline 185-191). It was not made a continuously enforced execution policy by this patch.

Provider-internal awaits/live commands and operating-system path identity are not continuously reauthorized or cancelled. Those baseline lifecycle/TOCTOU semantics were not presented as new patch defects or as fixed by this review.

Arbitrary mutation of SQLite rows by an actor already controlling the private state directory is outside the owner/enrolled API boundary. Static checks still verified malformed kind/selector denial; no extra untrusted database writer was found in the scoped callers.
